title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in IdeaBox…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in IdeaBox Creations PowerPack Lite for Beaver Builder up to version 1.3.2. This vulnerability arises from improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing attackers to inject malicious scripts that can be executed in the context of users' browsers.
